description: Dated prices for one product: today's verified price for this exact model (price_verified; when it is not verified the price is null and price_unverified_reason says Price not confirmed and why), when iDevice began checking it (tracking_since) and on how many days (history_days). The lowest price (lowest, lowest_basis, lowest_since, lowest_label) covers recent published prices and iDevice's own checks of this exact model, one price a day, and is named once there is enough price history; lowest_checked, low_period and low_period_days carry the same figure for one release, and lowest_last_90_days is null. lowest_last_30_days is the recent low and high of iDevice's own checks. Also the researched history (first and last observation, range, the points themselves, with bundles and refurbs marked and left out of the range).
name: get_price_history
title: Price history
